# adbc v0.12.1 - Table of Contents

Apache Arrow ADBC bindings for Elixir

## Modules

- [Adbc](https://adbc.hexdocs.pm/Adbc.md): Bindings for Arrow Database Connectivity (ADBC).
- [Adbc.Column](https://adbc.hexdocs.pm/Adbc.Column.md): Represents columns in the table.
- [Adbc.Connection](https://adbc.hexdocs.pm/Adbc.Connection.md): Documentation for `Adbc.Connection`.
- [Adbc.Database](https://adbc.hexdocs.pm/Adbc.Database.md): Documentation for `Adbc.Database`.
- [Adbc.Field](https://adbc.hexdocs.pm/Adbc.Field.md): Represents the schema definition of a column.

- Result types
  - [Adbc.IngestResult](https://adbc.hexdocs.pm/Adbc.IngestResult.md): Represents the result of an `Adbc.Connection.ingest/2` operation.
  - [Adbc.Result](https://adbc.hexdocs.pm/Adbc.Result.md): A struct returned as result from queries.
  - [Adbc.StreamResult](https://adbc.hexdocs.pm/Adbc.StreamResult.md): Represents an unmaterialized Arrow stream.

- Exceptions
  - [Adbc.Error](https://adbc.hexdocs.pm/Adbc.Error.md)
